prompt: A lift in an office building starts from rest at the ground floor, accelerates upwards at a constant rate for 3.0 s, travels at a constant velocity for 8.0 s, and then decelerates at a constant rate for 4.0 s to come to rest at the tenth floor. What is the geometric shape of the velocity-time graph representing this journey, and what does the total area under this graph represent?
options: A trapezium above the time axis; total area represents the height of the tenth floor above the ground floor.
A triangle above the time axis; total area represents the average speed of the lift.
A rectangle above the time axis; total area represents the total time of the journey.
A trapezium crossing the time axis; total area represents the maximum speed reached.

answer.explanation: The motion consists of three linear stages: a positive slope from rest (acceleration), a horizontal line (constant velocity), and a negative slope to rest (deceleration). Together these form a trapezium lying entirely above the time axis. The area under a velocity-time graph represents displacement, which here is the vertical height climbed.

distractor_explanations: Correct. The graph is a trapezium (ramp up, flat top, ramp down) and its area represents displacement (height climbed).
Incorrect. The constant-velocity phase creates a horizontal top edge, forming a trapezium rather than a triangle.
Incorrect. Ignores the acceleration and deceleration periods.
Incorrect. The lift moves solely upwards, so velocity never becomes negative and the graph does not cross the time axis.
hints: Sketch the velocity-time graph from the verbal description: ramping up, flat, ramping down.
Recall what physical quantity is represented by the total area under a velocity-time graph.
solution: A. A trapezium above the time axis; total area represents the height of the tenth floor above the ground floor.
teacher_walkthrough: Step 1: Translate the words into graphical features: accelerates from rest -> linear rise from v=0; constant velocity -> horizontal line; decelerates to rest -> linear drop to v=0.
Step 2: Identify the combined geometric figure as a trapezium above the time axis.
Step 3: Recall the physical meaning of area under a v-t graph: area = displacement = vertical height climbed.
Step 4: Conclude that option 1 is the correct match.
